title: Palindrome Checker — Alternative Review Record

metadata.prompt: Write a function that checks whether a string is a palindrome, ignoring case and non-alphanumeric characters.
metadata.provenance_note: Illustrative second record for demonstrating the comparison command; not a measured model output.

task: Return True when the input string is a palindrome after lowercasing and removing non-alphanumeric characters. Empty normalized strings are considered palindromes.

findings.title: Punctuation-only inputs need an explicit policy
findings.evidence: The requirement defines empty normalized strings as palindromes, but this behavior should be represented by a dedicated regression test.
findings.recommendation: Add tests for an empty string and a string containing only punctuation, and document the chosen behavior.

tests.name: spaces and punctuation
tests.input: "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama!"

summary: Second illustrative record to demonstrate A/B comparison output.
